CRITROLLS.Title: Critical Rolls

Missing.column: Could not determine the attack type or damage type: choose the effect manually from the book.
Missing.entry: The table has no entry for the rolled result.

Duration.turnEnd: until the end of the turn

Note.noTargetSelect: no target: select a token and press the button again
Note.critNone: no change to the damage roll is needed
Note.alreadyApplied: already applied earlier, not applied again

Tick.start: At the start of the turn
Tick.end: At the end of the turn
Tick.startFlavor: Damage at the start of the turn {type}
Tick.endFlavor: Damage at the end of the turn {type}

Item.Replaced: The previous item of this kind was replaced
Item.Kept: Item not given: the character already has one
Item.Used: This card's item was already used, so a new one was not given

Dialog.BothHint: If you keep both, the player chooses which one to apply when using the item.

CRITROLLS.NoGM: The GM is offline: only the GM can decide.

Skipped.combat: {name}: the critical miss effect is not rolled, because it has already happened in this combat.
Skipped.round: {name}: the critical miss effect is not rolled, because it has already happened this round.

Tables.UpToDate: Critical Rolls tables are already up to date.

Manual.ToolHint: A chat card as after a real 1 or 20: choose the section, attack or damage type, character and, optionally, the table number. The /cr chat command does the same.
Manual.GMOnly: The /cr command is available to the GM only.
Manual.Title: Set effect manually
Manual.TableHint: From 1 to 60. If empty, the number is rolled at random, taking the party level into account.
Manual.Targets: Targets: {names}. “On target” effects will apply to them.
Manual.NoTargets: No targets selected: “on target” effects will have to be applied after a target is chosen.
Manual.NeedActor: Luck and fumble effects need a character: the item is given to them.

sections.Title: Sections
sections.Hint:
Off: the section does nothing.
Confirm: the effect applies after the “Apply” button is pressed.
Auto: the effect applies immediately.

decisions.Title: Who decides and how it looks
decisions.Hint: Who sees the window and the buttons on the cards, and whether effects are applied automatically.

signals.Title: Sound and highlight
signals.Hint: Hidden rolls and hidden tokens give no signal.

tables.Title: Tables in the sidebar
tables.Hint: The Tables sidebar contains a Critical Rolls folder with the tables from the book. The tables themselves do not apply effects: use a manual roll for that.

tracked.Title: Which rolls luck and fumble apply to
tracked.Hint: Shown when the luck or fumble section is on.

miss.Name: Critical misses
miss.Hint: 1 on an attack roll (by a player or a monster). The effect depends on the attack type: melee, ranged, natural or magic.

hitGM.Name: Critical hits for the GM
hitGM.Hint: 20 on an enemy attack against a hero. The effect depends on the damage type and applies to the hero.

hitPC.Name: Critical hits for players
hitPC.Hint: 20 on an attack by a player or their ally. The effect depends on the damage type and applies to the target.

fumble.Name: Fumble effects
fumble.Hint: 1 on any d20 roll by a player (including attacks). The player receives a “Fumble” item.

luck.Name: Luck effects
luck.Hint: 20 on any d20 roll by a player (including attacks). The player receives a “Luck” item.

playerParticipates.Name: Player takes part in the choice
playerParticipates.Hint: The character's owner also sees the decision window and the “Apply”, “Decline” and “Reroll” buttons, and decides their own effect.

showDialog.Name: Show the decision window
showDialog.Hint: The decision window opens for whoever decides and duplicates the buttons on the card in chat.

applyEffects.Name: Apply effects automatically
applyEffects.Hint: Conditions, modifiers and damage without conditions are applied on their own once the decision is made. Effects “after a failed saving throw” and “at the GM's discretion” are applied with a button. When off, everything is applied with buttons only.

critRule.Name: What counts as a “20”
critRule.Hint: “By system rules”: the threshold depends on the character. For a Champion and heroes with weapons that lower the critical threshold it is 19–20; for everyone else, and for monsters, only 20. “Pure 20”: the threshold is 20 for everyone, including monsters.

missLimit.Name: Critical miss effect
missLimit.Hint: How often a player or a monster gets a miss effect. If the effect is declined, the next miss is rolled again. Outside combat there is no limit.

pingEnabled.Name: Highlight the token
pingEnabled.Hint: The roller's token pulses: gold on a 20, red on a 1. Everyone on the same scene sees it.

autoTables.Name: Create tables automatically
autoTables.Hint: Tables in the sidebar are created and updated automatically when the GM joins the world.

ceilingMode.Name: Table ceiling by party level
ceilingMode.Hint: The higher the group's level, the more dangerous the tables that can come up: the next risk level opens at levels 1, 5, 9 and 13. If a table above the ceiling is rolled, it is rolled again. Only characters with a player owner count; if there are none, there is no ceiling.

duplicatePolicy.Name: If the character already has a luck or fumble item
duplicatePolicy.Hint: A character has at most one item of each kind. The new one can replace the old one or not be given.

trackDeathSaves.Name: Track death saving throws
trackDeathSaves.Hint: Off by default: a 1 or 20 on a death saving throw already has its own rules.

trackInitiative.Name: Track initiative
trackInitiative.Hint: Luck and fumble effects for a 1 and 20 on initiative.

trackFreeRolls.Name: Track free rolls
trackFreeRolls.Hint: Rolls such as /r 1d20 that are not made from a character sheet. Off so that chat rolls do not trigger effects.

debug.Name: Debug
debug.Hint: Details of the module's work in the browser console (F12). Needed only when looking for errors.

trackAttacks.Name: Attacks
trackAttacks.Hint: Luck and fumble from a natural 1 or 20 on an attack. Off by default.

trackChecks.Name: Ability and skill checks
trackChecks.Hint: Luck and fumble from a natural 1 or 20 on a check.

trackSaves.Name: Saving throws
trackSaves.Hint: Luck and fumble from a natural 1 or 20 on a saving throw.
